verdict.rationale: Shortwave has a documented keyboard-shortcuts reference page with a Shift+? overlay. Community and founder comments point to a fast interface built on Gmail's APIs with latency compensation. But the shortcut set's breadth is never described, and no command palette appears in the evidence. Missing for 10: any evidence of a command palette, documentation of how comprehensive the shortcuts are (full keyboard-only operation), independent hands-on confirmation of keyboard-driven workflows, and concrete performance measurements.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can do everything from the keyboard — comprehensive shortcuts and a command palette — in an interface fast enough to never make me wait
